# LLM Provider Failure Handling

If the embedding provider fails, all remaining entities in the batch are marked as pending without validating the cause of the failure, potentially leading to inconsistent state or repeated failures during subsequent attempts to process the same entities.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/retrieval/embed.py` — `knowledge_compiler.retrieval.embed.emit_embeddings`
